description:
Aggregator for the ntfy Quarkus extension. A Quarkus extension is split into two
        artifacts by convention: the RUNTIME module (the user-facing dependency, carrying the
        JUL log handler, the run-time @ConfigMapping, the recorder and the CDI producer) and the
        DEPLOYMENT module (the build-time processor that wires the handler in via a
        LogHandlerBuildItem and registers the config).
